verdict.rationale: Homebrew docs show a Brewfile mechanism for encoding project dependencies and installed-state snapshots (brew bundle dump/install), but Brewfiles record package names, not exact pinned versions, and there's no documented per-project version-pinning mechanism respected by the manager. Community evidence explicitly contradicts this story: a user reports being 'screwed too many times on mandatory upgrades I couldn't pin' and switching to Mise, another complains Homebrew lacks a standard way to install/pin multiple versions of tools like node/php/Python, relying on pyenv/nvm instead. missing for 10: documented per-formula/project version pinning respected across installs, evidence Brewfile can lock exact versions, resolution of the community-reported pinning failures.
